latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker Renderforest — Initial Release

- Instantly create animated promo videos from text, images, or audio with automatic cloud rendering.
- Upload MP4, JPG, PNG, or MP3 files up to 200MB; AI handles editing and compositing.
- Receive 30-second, 1080p video exports within 1–2 minutes.
- Session-based workflow: tracks video state for instant preview, edits, and export.
- Simple setup: automatic token generation for quick start, no account required (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
